content.name: Power Word Heal
entries: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. If the creature has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52}, {@condition Frightened|SRD52}, {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52}, {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, or {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to stand up.
